note: Estimates from weight sizes in config/server_model_lock.json plus working memory at the default sizes. Every number is hardware_pending until the bake-off measures it; outputs/hardware_map.json can move a family without code.

gpu0.role: image, edit and 3D (one family resident at a time)

gpu1.role: video (one family resident at a time)

director.why: default profile is a 3B-active MoE: attention and KV cache on GPU0, experts in the 256 GB RAM; the video lane keeps a whole card
director.unlisted_why: only profiles listed here share GPU0 beside the image lane; any other profile, whatever its size, takes GPU1 exclusively and the video lane pauses while it is loaded. The registry's own placement and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES are ignored.

scorer.runtime: not wired yet: S4 plate QA adds it (llama-server with a pinned GGUF and mmproj of the locked scorer model); until then no scorer unit
scorer.why_port: 8000-8003 are the Director profiles' ports (8001 is Strata DeepSeek)

exclusive_profiles.why: a Director profile above 70 GB (wave 4) takes GPU1; the video lane pauses while it is loaded
